neighbours.label: 'bo' of oboe and obovate, 'dependent' of interdependent: a list; flute, narrow and whole-token ' independent' stay quiet
fire: She plays the oboe in the town orchestra.
An oboe solo opens the second movement.
The leaves are obovate with a pointed tip.
Rainforests and reefs are interdependent systems.
Nations have grown more interdependent since the war.
The oboe player arrived late to rehearsal.
Plants and insects are deeply interdependent.
Many obovate leaves grow along the upper stem.
quiet: She plays the flute in the town orchestra.
A cello solo opens the second movement.
The leaves are narrow with a pointed tip.
Rainforests and reefs are complex systems.
Nations have grown more independent since the war.
The drum player arrived late to rehearsal.
Plants and insects are deeply different.
Many oval leaves grow along the upper stem.

notes: Card: 'bo' x6, 'dependent' x6, 'dependence' x4, 'depend' x3, 'dependency' x2. Probe: obovate 1.02, oboe 0.99, interdependent 0.97; flute 0.03, whole-token independent 0.01. Its tokenization matters: 'dependent' as a split-off piece fires; whole-token ' independent' does not.
